title: Backlink & outreach tracker
notes: Track legitimate outreach only. Prefer citations, partner pages, resource mentions, and earned PR. Avoid PBNs and paid spam networks.
workflow: 1. Add prospect domains from the citation kit or partner list
2. Send outreach using a template (mark outreach-sent)
4. When live, paste the URL, set status=live, and note the anchor
5. Re-check quarterly; mark lost if the link disappears
